layer.capability: Rowwise formal coefficient oracle with conditional finite Picard stabilization under the pinned radial filtration.

picard_stabilization.induction: x^(r) agrees with the fixed point through rows <= r
picard_stabilization.row_n_depth: formal row n agrees with x^(n)_n and all later Picard iterates
picard_stabilization.scope: conditional exact-arithmetic identity; not convergence certification

conditional_banach_limit_identification.norm_limit_route: The complete-space contraction construction invokes ContractingWith.exists_fixedPoint'; an exact Picard sequence therefore converges under the theorem hypotheses
conditional_banach_limit_identification.coefficient_evaluation_bound: AxisCoefficientSpace.continuous_jet:55-69 and abs_jet_sub_le:216-220; abs_jet_le:202-208 bounds the limiting projection
conditional_banach_limit_identification.logic: If exact Picard x^(r) agrees with x* through row r, radial causality gives agreement of R through row r+1; for fixed n the row stabilizes at r>=n, and bounded evaluation identifies that stabilized row with x*
conditional_banach_limit_identification.formal_prefix_norm: No independent global norm proof is needed for each finite formal prefix once the theorem-side compatible x* and its all-index norm witness are supplied
conditional_banach_limit_identification.status: manual conditional corollary; not separately formalized in Lean at the pinned commit
conditional_banach_limit_identification.runtime_gap: The local Decimal96/float jet oracle still lacks an exact or interval-certified equality bridge to theorem-side coefficient projections
